blocks.text: That guarantee resets the moment you obtain a featured 5 star, so it is a running counter rather than something you bank permanently. Plan around 100 and treat anything earlier as luck.

Pulls are called Revelations, and you spend Judgement Shots to carry them out. Limited banners are Limited-Time Repertoires, and all of them share the same featured 5 star guarantee mechanic. The Vengeful Ant is one such Limited-Time Repertoire.

items.label: Currency
items.name: Judgement Shots
items.text: The currency spent to perform Revelations on a banner.

items.label: The pulls
items.name: Revelations
items.text: The pulls themselves. Guarantees are all counted in Revelations.

items.label: Limited banner
items.name: Limited-Time Repertoire
items.text: A limited banner. Every one uses the same featured 5 star guarantee, which resets when you get the featured character.

blocks.title: A 5 star is not always the one you want
blocks.text: The 5 star pool covers both the current featured character and the standard characters, so a 5 star landing does not by itself mean you got the one you wanted. The featured guarantee at 100 Revelations is what removes that risk.

items.title: Every 10 Revelations give at least one 4 star
items.text: The 4 star base rate is 6%, rising to 13% overall once this guarantee is counted in.

items.title: Half of your 4 stars are featured
items.text: When 4 star content appears there is a 50% chance it is a current featured 4 star, with featured characters sharing that chance equally and non featured ones sharing the rest equally.

items.title: Every 20 Revelations give a featured 4 star
items.text: So a featured 4 star is never more than twenty pulls away.

items.title: Every 100 Revelations give a featured 5 star
items.text: The base 5 star rate is 0.8% and the overall rate is 1.8%. Once you obtain the featured 5 star, this counter resets.

items.label: Revelations to a 5 star Motive, rather than 100

blocks.text: The Motive banner runs on the same Revelation counters but targets weapons, and it has no featured character split to worry about.

blocks.text: Duplicates are not wasted. Every copy past the first converts into that character Trait and pays out shards, and the payout increases once you pass the seventh copy.

items.label: Characters
items.name: Mind Shards
items.text: Shards paid with every character you pull. Copies 2 to 7 also give the Trait.

blocks.title: How the game words the rule
blocks.text: The game words the duplicate rule as the next six duplicates after the first copy, then an increased rate from the seventh duplicate onward, which is the eighth copy overall.

Save 100 Revelations for a featured character you actually want. That figure is the only hard guarantee on the character banner, and because it resets once the featured character arrives, going in with a full 100 means you cannot miss.
For Motives the equivalent number is 80. If you are chasing a specific featured 4 star instead, 20 Revelations is enough, which makes featured 4 stars by far the cheapest targeted pull in the game.
